title: RNA foundation model guides design of toehold switches with up to 35-fold ON/OFF ratio
summary: Ernie-Switcher built on the RNAErnie foundation model to generate and filter RNA toehold switch designs under biophysical constraints. The abstract reports optimised switches with ON/OFF ratios up to 35-fold in E. coli, and a lower bound on landscape navigability of 86.4%. The number of constructs tested and baselines are not stated in the abstract.

evidence.tested: Expression assays of designed toehold switches in E. coli.
evidence.unknown: Number of constructs tested and baseline comparisons not stated in the abstract; full text not reviewed.
